metadata.scope: C++ metadata and symbol addresses; memory layout is not wire serialization order; virtual overrides need base-slot verification.

scope: Matched 2193 normal reflection writer for fade time/color presence and field order. This is static evidence, not a runtime capture or complete camera-handler equivalence claim.

wire_presence.payload_condition: Each optional writer always writes its own presence bool; its three-float payload is written only when that optional is present.

resolution: Correct only protocol/legacy/bedrock-1.26.51.json: fade contains optional time_data {fade_in_duration,wait_duration,fade_out_duration}, then optional color_rgb. The old flat schema incorrectly omitted both inner presence bytes. No synthetic defaults or field-relocation bridge is needed.

tests.fade_cases: Both present, time only, color only, both absent, outer fade absent; nondefault durations 2/3/4 and colors 0.25/0.5/0.75; separate encoding and decoding literals for 2193 and 2225; truncated payload rejection.
tests.combined_camera_result: 168 checks; 22 expected failures with original 2193 camera schema, zero failures with corrected schemas and known-label mapping.
tests.live_consumer: ServerUiPackets selftest injects literal 2193 zero-fade-in/ten-second-hold color and reads public camera tint without sleeping. Final app execution is owned by the integration run.

limits: The native fade duration/color validation and visual transition behavior were not reconstructed by this narrow wire trace.
Malformed/noncanonical optional bool handling was not traced.
Default codec values and literal fixture success are not proof of every CameraInstruction field or every protocol profile.
